text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Watching Inari-chan eat...
She kind of looks like a cute little squirrel. ♪

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Who're you calling a squirrel?! I've been an
Umamusume since the day I was born!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I know, I know~
Here, please eat up.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well, if I'm being completely honest, I kinda
feel like eating a little bit more dessert...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"No, no! Believe it or not, I watch what I eat.
I ain't gonna lose to temptation!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I might grow taller,
but I ain't gettin' wider!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, what? What's the matter?
Clamming up all of a sudden.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...Starting now, I think I'll begin doing morning runs for a while!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to all the running,
Super Creek's tummy
was firmly toned.
